newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur sees double-digit profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur sees double-digit profit rise.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co said good first half results formed a reliable basis on which full year profits should show a double-digit growth rate.

"Together with reserves, which have already been created under consideration of deferrals and accruals, the good results of the first six months forms a reliable basis on which to achieve another double-digit growth rate in profits in the current business year and a marked increase in the shareholders equity by the end of 1996," Winterthur chairman Peter Spaelti said in remarks prepared for a news conference.
Spaelti said Winterthur was expecting improved results both in non-life and in life operations.
In 1995 Winterthur's group net profit rose 15.1 percent to 419.2 million Swiss francs.
